caption: The drawing depicts a single object, a double-edged tool with a wooden handle and a metal head, placed against a light beige background. The head of the tool has a broad, curved blade on one side and a long, pointed hook or spike on the other. The blade is rendered in shades of brown and gray, with a slightly rusted or weathered appearance. The wooden handle is shown in natural brown tones with variations and grain patterns visible, and the handle curves slightly, ending in a broader, rounded end. Near the tool, on the right side of the drawing, is an inscription in capital letters: “DRAWN TO 1/2 ACTUAL SIZE ELMER. G. ANDERSON.”
title: Fireman's Axe
